question: Does retaining publicly observable object identity in pre-pooling frozen spatial features improve current-state readout?
scope: Current state only; no dynamics modification or rollout claim
frozen_encoder_inputs: Existing DINO cache and original common20 normalization; spatial Transformer frozen, pre-global-mean 256-dimensional token output; both pools use the same frozen observation LayerNorm/Linear to 512D
supervision: All 40 training roots, 3 episodes x 5 boundaries = 600 records; same targets and schedule both arms. Old common20 linear probes are not a matched comparator.

arms.global: Focal vector is global mean over valid spatial output tokens including robot, projected through frozen observation LN/Linear to 512D, repeated for each requested color; zero focal if that color is unresolved/invisible, same fallback as object arm
arms.object: Focal vector is mean over valid ROI output tokens publicly registered to the requested color across ONLY the current four frames and two cameras, then the same frozen observation LN/Linear to 512D; zero if unresolved/invisible

shared_context: Same projected 512D global mean, same learned color query, same per-color visible-token fraction for BOTH arms; no extra boxes/geometry/confidence for either head
head: Shared LayerNorm(1057)-Linear(1057,256)-SiLU-Linear(256,8) object classifier plus identity embedding(3,32); separate shared scene LayerNorm(512)-Linear(512,64)-SiLU-Linear(64,3) drawer classifier
route_source: Existing VisibleRegistry public RGB mean-color tests and anonymous visible masks; raw simulator UID/name only in separate offline routing AUDIT, never to construct features
route_unseen: No GT fallback, no guessed UID; zero object focal plus availability=0 if no visible registered token; fresh registration per boundary, restricted to the current four frames; no identity information from earlier episode history
routing_gate: Stop before fitting for any incorrect registered color identity or cache geometry mismatch. Missing/ambiguous routing uses the fixed zero fallback, retains every sample, and is reported. Stop if unresolved among visibly present objects exceeds 5% in train or 10% in any heldout split. GT is used only for audit, never to repair mapping.
loss: Unweighted mean cross entropy of red, blue, pink location and drawer (4 fields); separate object/drawer gradient clipping keeps drawer updates identical between arms
schedule: Uniform root, then uniform one of 15 stored boundaries; materialized 1500x64 schedule per encoder block, shared arms
initialization_seed: 261019800 + encoder_seed; identical initial head weights within pair
compute: FP32 heads, no dropout; original BF16 encoder extraction, 4 episodes/batch matching original evaluator. No DINO recomputation.
selection: Final step 1500 only; no early stopping or hyperparameter search. All four heads frozen before validation/test/C prediction.

cohorts.h0: One branch b0 initial record per independent root
cohorts.all_boundaries: 15 boundary records per root, including repeated root starts; inferential unit remains root

primary: Object location class recalls/confusions and macro recall over supported classes
Holding positive recall, precision, false positive rate, identity errors, multiple-held conflicts, and exact held-object identity
InDrawer positive recall and false positive rate
evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired root-cluster resamples per encoder seed, stratified only by requested reporting subset; preserve all sibling records; no pooling the encoder seeds
evaluation.permutation: Randomly reorder the three object bundles together with requested identity and visibility; shared-head probabilities must follow the same permutation (max abs tolerance 1e-6). Plumbing/equivariance test, not semantic color-swap robustness.
evaluation.blindness: Exploratory reuse: test and C have already been inspected historically; no claim of new blind generalization.

interpretation.support: Object arm improves supported-class macro recall and Holding identity/positive recall consistently across two blocks without a material InDrawer regression; paired intervals and denominators shown. Supports usefulness of identity-conditioned selection for these frozen features, not proof global pooling is sole cause.
interpretation.mixed_or_null: Report as mixed/null, inspect frozen-feature and supervision limitations; no automatic extra run or conclusion that world-model approach fails.
interpretation.confounds: Object arm receives structured public color-to-ROI association restricted to current four frames; content selection and pooling information differ. Equal parameter count/context cannot separate association advantage from bottleneck preservation. Spatial tokens are already contextualized; this is not training a new object encoder.

stops: Frozen state or sealed file hash change
More than 45 minutes compute: stop and report, do not expand budget
